narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Shubman is better, because ninety is the highest score of all.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Ninety is a fine innings, but it is only one match.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>In his other three matches he made zero, seventeen and twenty one.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>One big score can hide many small ones.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>With the same number of matches, the totals and the gaps tell more.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. One friend scores two, nine, one and eight, and another scores five, six, four and seven. Who did better?
